reviews.text: I challenge anyone to find a more comfortable environment for their cats while they are away.  The facility is calm, the staff is extremely kind and the care they provide for your pet while you are away is exceptional.  They have an environment of aromatherapy, mood music, setup like a boutique hotel and provide play rooms and lots of attention.  In my opinion, they are probably the best location for cat boarding in all of Portugal.

I love this cat hotel! The space is modern, very well organized, and all the rooms are air-conditioned. There are many toys and private spaces with glass partitions that allow the cats to observe what's happening around them and the owners to keep an eye on everything.

The owners are extremely attentive and helpful. They send photos every day, give updates on how our cat is doing, and are always careful to ask about food, quantities, and any special needs.

I feel my cat is in good hands! I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a cat hotel where care, organization, and attention to the animals truly make a difference!
Everything went very well with my kitten. Everyone seemed attentive and professional. Thank you.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire Petssionate Boutique team for the care they've given our cat, Estrela. She was always treated very well by Paulo and Ana, and that made all the difference for us. Thank you so much for all the care and attention!

This was the second time Blue stayed with you during my vacation, and both of us were satisfied. The accommodations are comfortable, and the fact that they can also move around the common area for part of the day is very important.
Thank you for the care and attention you gave him.

Our family member stayed with Petssionate Hotel twice and loved both times. The owners are wonderful and really care about their guests and have built a beautiful place. The hotel is spacious, clean, and safe. Highly recommend! 5-Stars!
A marvel, super attentive and careful. My cat was treated very well. An experience to repeat.

A lovely hotel, with caring owners and a spacious place for cats. Honestly it’s always a stress for me to leave our cat but I know that our cat (Puh) actually loves Petssionate. When we come back - Puh is always cheerful and it’s noticeable that he has a great time at the hotel.
Once, when Puh had some eye problems, the owners gave him the medicine according to the instructions that we gave them. On top of that, a lot of rooms are equipped with cameras but even without the cameras we always get a lot of videos and photos of our cat. Puh already stayed like ~7 times at Petssionate and we know we will return.

I always leave my cat, White, at the Petssionate Boutique Hotel with complete peace of mind when I go on vacation. I have total confidence in the team because I know he is treated with great care, attention, and professionalism. It's clear that they genuinely care for the animals' well-being, and that puts me completely at ease. It's wonderful to be able to travel knowing that our cat is in good hands and happy. I couldn't recommend them more!

A true 5-legged (star) experience!
Given that my kitten is only 3 months old and is our first pet, you can imagine our initial concerns. However, from our first visit, Paulo's spectacular service and the hotel's facilities put us completely at ease.
The passionate way Paulo introduced us to the place and how it works, his availability and attention during check-in and throughout the stay, always sending us videos and news about our Mel, gave us the confidence that she would not only be in good hands but would also have a luxurious and pampered vacation.
The attention and constant pampering that Raquel (veterinary nurse) provided during the stay was also very reassuring.
And at check-out, the way Ana spoke to us about Mel's stay and the service provided by the hotel confirmed the passion, quality, and competence that Petsionnate Boutique Hotel offers.
Although there are cheaper places, the price-quality ratio of Petsionate is very good. Besides the incredible facilities, the human touch is their greatest luxury.

We are certain that our kitten will return there again.
We highly recommend it.

A sincere thank you to the entire team at The Petssionate boutique hotel.
Great place and very nice people !

I do not recommend this place at all. Ana seemed attentive and concerned during check-in, but she did not follow any of the explicit instructions regarding my cat's care, including administering medication, which was returned to me without a single pill having been given. Now my cat is sick. We paid a lot of money for this place, but it's all a sham. They only care about getting the money and become very unpleasant when we complain about their shortcomings.
Paulo's service was impeccable.

Incredible experience, we are very happy with the decision to leave our kittens in the care of Petssionate, Paulo and Ana, much gratitude for taking such good care of our babies.
We found our kittens happy, calm, without shedding, very affectionate with the caregivers.
The hotel has excellent conditions, plenty of space for the animals to play and lots of equipment to stimulate them.
We feel that we can travel with peace of mind knowing that our animals are very well cared for.
From our side, only much GRATITUDE.

Great place to leave your furry cat friend for a day or days. It's like a 5-star hotel for cats! Ana was extremely helpful and friendly and gave us a tour of the place. We were able to see our kitten over live CCTV and received videos of her playing. Highly recommend!
The staff takes great care of the animals. The facilities are very good, with plenty of space for the animals to play. My cat always gets along very well there. I recommend it to everyone.

Ana and Paulo are two wonderful professionals. My cat went to the hotel and came back so happy, sociable, and active. He was on vacation at Petssionate and loved being there.

I received several videos of my furry friend every day, and I can't describe the peace of mind they gave me!

Just like we go on vacation, all kittens deserve the Petssionate Boutique Hotel at least once a year!

My cat Sushi LOVED his stay. Lots of parties and playtime. He came back relaxed and super well-groomed. I think he wasn't bothered at all, and maybe he even preferred to stay there forever 🤣
The space is amazing! With a lounge and gym and lots of interesting things for cats to explore. Spectacular! 🐈
We will definitely repeat! 🥰

It was the first time I left my kitten at a hotel and the experience couldn't have been better. Attentive and careful service. I felt at ease knowing that my Bennie was well taken care of. I recommend it!

The only hotel where I feel like I'm leaving my cat with family! The space is great, the care and attention they receive is perfect, and there isn't a single day that they don't send us updates on how the stay is going. I trust them completely!
Lovely pet hotel. Affordable and clean accommodation with friendly owners who clearly love taking care of the kitties.

This is the best cat hotel!! I know my cat gets lots of love and special attention here. The team are so caring and wonderful and really treat him like royal family. Sometimes my cat is not ready to come back home!

My beloved cat Flora stayed at the Petssionate Hotel Boutique for a few days and it couldn't have gone better 😊 It was her first experience. She was very well treated and I received videos and photos every day. When I picked her up, she was calm. And that can only be the best indicator that everything went really well. I highly recommend it.

We loved the space and the people!! 5 ⭐!! Our Bluey was very well looked after and enjoyed it a lot!! 😻😺
Thank you so much Petssionate! …

My cat has stayed at Petssionate several times and I cannot recommend their care and overall service highly enough. While I don't like to leave my kitty, I know that if I do need to travel out of town that he will be in great hands with the team at Petssionate. The most recent stay my cat here was about 2 weeks, and I regularly received messages and photos/videos on how he was doing. Always a smiling welcome when I arrive, and sometimes a surprise gift when we leave. If you are looking for cat boarding facilities in Lisbon, stop your search because you have found it.
Excellent experience ! The place is very clean and people are very nice !! I recommend if you want to travel and don’t have any stress.
The best place in the city to leave your family member. Amazing care by the owner and very Nice accomodations!

Excellent facilities and a team committed to providing the best for the cats, for which I am grateful.
Very professional, friendly and dedicated.
An excellent place for small cats.

I can't speak well of the fantastic Petssionate team and the personalized, high-quality service they provide. The first time I used this hotel, I had a kitten needing specific care due to kidney disease. The Petssionate team easily ensured all her needs were met, allowing us to go on vacation worry-free. They diligently keep us informed, sending daily photos and videos of the kittens, which greatly reassures us. We have been clients since July 2023 and since then we have no doubts about where to leave our cats whenever we go on vacation, knowing they will be excellently cared for. We have already left three kittens in the care of this team, one of whom is a regular client and loves going on vacation to Petssionate :) We highly recommend them!

Beautiful, clean space! The staff is extremely friendly and very willing to send videos, photos, and information! We really enjoyed it and recommend it to anyone who needs it! Thank you so much for taking care of Roma in our absence! :)
Without a doubt, a trustworthy hotel 🙌🏼 They are amazing with our little ones. A wonderful experience, and one we'll repeat whenever we need to leave our Tom in a safe place ♥️ …

This is my go to cat hotel when I travel. I have a siamese cat that hates being alone. She gets lots of attention and personal care. The staff is very dedicated. My cat has stayed there 3 times in average for 10 days. Only negative point would be lack of outdoor space.
They will treat your baby like princes, and are super reactive and flexible. Warm thank you to the team, we will come back ☺️🐱 …

I had my cat for the first time in a cat hotel... and it was the most reliable, stress free experience from the moment I walked into the space... the owner is so patient with all our questions and so passionate about all the guests (which he knows by name)... I received daily updates and my cat was happy, taken care of and loved just like at home!!! Very impressed, highly recommend and we are clients for life!!!

Exceptional professionals, very attentive and caring. 5-star space and very well maintained. My daughter Izma is always looked after by Paulo and his team during our holidays/absences from the country and is always very well treated. Thank you and I highly recommend them!

You have zero worries to leave your cats here! The hotel rooms of all sizes are well fitted with multiple levels so they can jump and hide. There are two big playrooms with everything a cat could want, including steps and nooks up the walls.

I get so many photos and videos of my cat exploring the space during his time out of his room. He makes friends through the glass doors of other rooms and loooooves the playrooms. The staff even let him wander around a bit and he likes to hide in a cupboard, same as at home.

He is so happy when I pick him up. It's like a resort for cats.

Cannot recommend this place enough!

My kitten has stayed at this hotel twice and has always been very well received. I must highlight the facilities, and Paulo, Ana, and Diana, who have angelic patience with all the little friends who stay there. It will always be my first choice and the place I trust to leave my little darling 😊 …

Could not recommend this place enough!

Paulo came in at 1am to take our cat and came in early in the morning for us to …
I want to share my gratitude for your work and dedication during Mel's stay. You were simply wonderful at every stage. I was very moved to see her doing so well.

After much searching, we managed to find a hotel that inspired the utmost confidence, not only for its magnificent facilities, but also for the friendliness, kindness, and professionalism of everyone. …

Our kittens have stayed at PetssionateBoutiqueHotel three times already. They always come back even more pampered and cuddly than when they left! The love and attention they give to all the kittens who pass through there is impressive! I …
